P01: PIN sign-in on a device registered to a branch, idle lock, sign-out. Mock only; real sign-in needs an ERPNext method.
P02: Role home = task queue from the mock. Task roles (cashier, rider) get tiles and no menu.
P03: Sync tray: shows every queued item with owner and error, retry for failed items. No discard by design.
P06: A5 sales invoice and receipt only, follows the VAT mode and shows split payments and balance on credit. Statement, delivery note, transfer note and payout advice are not built.
S01: Scan or search, cart, cash/transfer/card/credit/other, split and part-credit payments, VAT inclusive/added/none, offline queue, COPY receipts.
S02: Park and resume; resume is refused while a sale is in progress.
S03: Open a shift with the opening balance; closing goes through the closing balance count (Q01). Works offline (queued). Difference reason codes are placeholders until supplied.
S04: Search with credit terms and available credit; works from this device's remembered customers when offline.
CR01: Pulled forward from Sprint 3 and partly built inside the till: credit needs a customer with terms and room under the limit (checked on the device and again by the server). Over-limit approval by a manager is NOT built (Sprint 3, depends on the approvals inbox).
A01: Approvals inbox: shows who, what, amount and limit; hold-to-confirm approve; reject with a required reason; creator never decides their own request; blocked offline. S05 raises discount and void requests from the till; the over-limit credit request (CR01) is next.
T01: Find the sale by invoice number, choose lines and quantities, give a reason, a manager approves the refund (default: two steps, see approval routing), then the return is completed once. Online only. Refund = what the customer paid for those lines (discount and VAT respected); a credit share reduces what the customer owes. Not built: restocking or quarantine of returned goods (Sprint 7), a printed credit note, returns while offline. Reasons are placeholders.
H02: Ask the warehouse for stock (search items, quantities, note) and see the requests with their status. Online only. Dispatch and receiving by the warehouse come in Sprint 4, so a request stays 'Requested' for now.
H03: Pick and pack by scanning (or +/-), send less than asked if needed, works offline (queued with an idempotency key). The person who asked cannot dispatch their own request. Not built: cancelling a request, re-requesting the part that was not sent.
H04: Count what arrived by scanning; missing items are flagged and open a ruling (who bears the loss) for someone independent; nothing is charged automatically. Works offline (queued). The person who dispatched cannot receive it. An item nobody counted is sent as zero. Not built: moving the missing items to a loss record in stock (Sprint 7 quarantine).
H05: Shelf and warehouse quantities with a low-stock flag; search by name, code or barcode; opens offline from the last saved list. Low-stock level (5) is fixed in code for now.
G02: Transfers on the road longer than `stock.inTransitAlertHours`; server-computed; opens offline from the last saved copy.
K01: Blind count by scanning or typing (an explicit 0 is counted); counts any location (shelf or warehouse); items that differ come back for a recount by a different person (setting); works offline (queued). Counts what you touch, so a cycle count of some items is allowed. Not built: a cut-off while stock is moving, a full-count checklist.
K02: Shows only the items that differ (system, counted, short or over) and asks for approval to adjust stock; stock changes only after the approval chain approves. Online only. The counter does not see the cost.
L01: Dispatch board: orders to assign (with a failed one's reason), out for delivery, delivered; assign to a rider from a list. Needs a connection. Orders are seeded in the mock (in ERPNext they come from Sales Orders). Not built: map view, route order, creating orders.
L02: The rider's own deliveries on a phone with a call link and the cash to collect; opens offline from the saved list. Only their own.
L03: Proof in 3 taps (Deliver, Delivered, Confirm), cash on delivery needs the full amount, a failed delivery needs a reason, optional photo (kept small), works offline (queued). Not built: signature, GPS.
L04: The rider picks the delivered cash to hand in and records it; a manager confirms in the inbox. Needs a connection. Not built: partial amounts.
L05: Delivery cash not yet handed in by rider, with hours and an overdue marker (`delivery.codRemitHours`); opens offline from the last saved copy.
